description: minimax-h3/generate's refusals: h3_generate_error(node, refs, first, last, width, height, frames = 124, videos = [], audios = []) → the run's error text, or null (contracts/README.md, the minimax-h3 family). refs = the number of image reference rows, first / last = whether those inputs are wired, frames = the clip's frames, videos = [seconds read, sound] per video row (sound: kept and the take has sound), audios = seconds read per audio row (API 1.22). The runner fails the run with the text before the h3 child starts
